<!-- SUB:SVC-API-INT:START traces=REQ-INV-019,REQ-INV-033,REQ-INV-040,REQ-INV-043,REQ-INV-044,REQ-INV-045,REQ-INV-046,REQ-INV-047,REQ-INV-048,REQ-INV-049,REQ-INV-050,REQ-INV-051,REQ-INV-052,REQ-INV-053,REQ-INV-058,REQ-INV-063,REQ-INV-069,REQ-INV-109,REQ-INV-110,REQ-INV-111,REQ-INV-112,REQ-INV-113,REQ-INV-114,REQ-INV-129,REQ-INV-130,REQ-INV-131,REQ-INV-057,REQ-INV-034,DBF-INV-066,DBF-INV-067,DBF-INV-068,DBF-INV-069,DBF-INV-075,DBF-INV-080,DBF-INV-052 -->
### In-process surface — `InventoryApi` (com.erp.inv.crossmodule)

One injected bean (conventions.module_interface: in_process — one deployable; no HTTP client, no base path, no
timeout, no network error path). The calling module authorises its own caller; tenancy applies to every call.
Quantities are in the Item's base unit (SRS D-05); every receive / issue / reserve carries an idempotency key
(text ≤ 64) — a repeated key returns the first answer and records nothing (RULE-INV-024, REQ-INV-058). Errors
are `LocalizedException` with the codes of §5 / §5.1. Every method reuses the services of the REST endpoints;
no method has a REST route (ADR-INV-024).

| Method | Honours | Implementation |
|---|---|---|
| readWarehouse(warehousePk) | CON-INV-006 | QR-INV-002 → {warehousePk, code, nameAr, nameEn, branchPk, isDefaultFl, isActiveFl}; inactive returned |
| listActiveWarehouses() | CON-INV-007 | QR-INV-001 (active only, all rows) + QR-INV-006 → {activeCount, warehouses} |
| readBranch(branchPk) | CON-INV-008 | QR-INV-009 → Branch; inactive returned |
| listActiveBranches() | CON-INV-009 | QR-INV-008 (active only) + QR-INV-013 → {activeCount, branches} |
| readAvailability(variantPk, warehousePk?) | CON-INV-010 | StockQueryService.availability (API-INV-017) |
| reserve(variantPk, warehousePk?, quantity, sourceDoc, idempotencyKey) | CON-INV-011 | see "Reserve" below |
| releaseReservation(reservationPk) | CON-INV-012 | see "Release" below |
| reservationsOfDocument(sourceDocTypeCode, sourceDocRef) | CON-INV-013 | reservations of the document (intent R-3), empty list when none |
| receiveStock(warehousePk?, RECEIPT / RETURN_IN, lines, sourceDoc, idempotencyKey) | CON-INV-014 | see "Receive" below |
| issueStock(warehousePk?, ISSUE / RETURN_OUT, saleFl, offlineFl, lines, sourceDoc, idempotencyKey) | CON-INV-015 | see "Issue" below |
| readValuation(variantPk) | CON-INV-016 | ValuationService.readByVariant (API-INV-051) |
| readLot(lotPk) | CON-INV-017 | QR-INV-039 + expiredFl |
| readItemStockSettings(itemPk) | CON-INV-018 | ItemStockSettingsService.readByItem (API-INV-044) |
| canTurnOff(lotExpiry / dualQuantity) | CON-INV-019 | QR-INV-042 filtered on the flag: count and the first 20 (Item code / names through integrate (XM-INV-015)); count > 0 → allowedFl false with the RULE-INV-046 message, {flag} = «التشغيلة والصلاحية» / "Lot and expiry" or «الكمية المزدوجة» / "Dual quantity", {count} = the count; unknown flag → INV-400 |
| event inv.StockMoveRecorded | CON-INV-020 | posting engine step 9 — {stockMovePk, docDate, moveTypeCode, variantPk, warehousePk, lotPk?, quantity, measureQty?, unitCost, moveValue, sourceDocTypeCode, sourceDocRef, sourceDocNo, sourceLineRef?, bundleVariantPk?, offlineFl}; a measure-only move carries quantity 0 (ADR-INV-017) |
| event inv.InventoryMasterChanged | CON-INV-021 | API-INV-003 … 007, 011 … 015 — {entity ENT-INV-001 / ENT-INV-002, identifier, changeKindCode} |

**Common resolution.** Warehouse: given → QR-INV-002 active (RULE-INV-007); absent → QR-INV-006 = 1 → default
(QR-INV-005), ≥ 2 → INV-422-WAREHOUSE-REQUIRED (RULE-INV-008, REQ-INV-013, 017). Quantity > 0, ≤ 3 dp
(RULE-INV-017). Variant active, STANDARD Item — integrate (XM-INV-014) (RULE-INV-018). Bundles on and the Variant
is a bundle → its active component lines integrate (XM-INV-012); none → INV-422-BUNDLE-NO-COMPONENTS
(RULE-INV-022); the request is exploded to the components (bundle quantity × component quantity) with
bundleVariantFk set (REQ-INV-049, 053).

**Reserve** (REQ-INV-043 … 045, 049). Idempotency: reservations with this key (R-2) → return them. Resolve → per
(component) Variant: lock the pair's lot-less balance row (QR-INV-017 — the serialisation point of reservations
and issues of that Variant × warehouse) → available = QR-INV-016 sellable − QR-INV-026 reserved → quantity >
available: INV_ALLOW_NEGATIVE_STOCK false → INV-409-RESERVE-NOT-AVAILABLE {available} (RULE-INV-020); true →
shortfall = quantity − max(available, 0) → insert (R-1) originalQty DBF-INV-067 = reservedQty DBF-INV-068 =
quantity, shortfallQty DBF-INV-069, sourceDocTypeCode / Ref / No / LineRef DBF-INV-070 … 073, idempotencyKey
DBF-INV-075, variantFk DBF-INV-076, warehouseFk DBF-INV-077, bundleVariantFk DBF-INV-078, docDate DBF-INV-079 =
today, statusCode DBF-INV-080 = ACTIVE. Concurrency: two reservations of the last units serialise on the pair
row; the second sees the first's reservation in QR-INV-026.

**Release** (REQ-INV-046, 048). Reservation by PK FOR UPDATE (R-4) → not ACTIVE → INV-409-RESERVATION-CLOSED
(RULE-INV-021) → statusCode RELEASED, reservedQty 0, closedAt DBF-INV-074 = now (R-5).

**Receive** (REQ-INV-051, 059, 064, 105 … 107, 120). Idempotency: moves with this key (R-6) → return them.
Resolve → per line: Item settings QR-INV-043 — lot-tracked with lotExpiry on → lot number and expiry required
(RULE-INV-035), lot reused or created (QR-INV-040 / 041; different expiry → RULE-INV-036); dual-quantity with
dualQuantity on → measure > 0 (RULE-INV-040); cost ≥ 0 or the average, none → RULE-INV-025 → posting engine
(RECEIPT / RETURN_IN; idempotencyKey DBF-INV-052 = the caller's key on every move). All lines or none.

**Issue** (REQ-INV-047, 052, 053, 067, 069, 110 … 114, 120). Idempotency (R-6). Resolve and explode → per line:
reservationPk given → reservation FOR UPDATE (R-4): not ACTIVE → RULE-INV-021; reservedQty −= issued (floor 0),
0 → CONSUMED with closedAt (R-5), and the moves carry reservationFk → lot selection: a sale (saleFl) of a
lot-tracked Variant with lotExpiry on → stock without a lot first (REQ-INV-112), then unexpired lots by ascending
expiry (REQ-INV-110; lots with expiryDate < today skipped — RULE-INV-038, REQ-INV-113), any remainder as a move
without a lot (REQ-INV-111); a non-sale line naming a lot whose expiry is before today → INV-422-LOT-EXPIRED
(RULE-INV-039, REQ-INV-114) → measure (RULE-INV-040) → posting engine with offlineFl (RULE-INV-019 skipped when
offlineFl is true — REQ-INV-069; the negative-crossing alert still fires). One answer may carry several moves per
line. All lines or none.

**In-process repository intents (not catalogued as QR — no API-* reaches them, ADR-INV-024).**
R-1 insert INV_RESERVATION; R-2 reservations by IDEMPOTENCY_KEY (IDX_INV_RESERVATION_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY);
R-3 reservations by SOURCE_DOC_TYPE_CODE + SOURCE_DOC_REF (IDX_INV_RESERVATION_SRC_TYPE_REF); R-4 reservation by
RESERVATION_PK FOR UPDATE; R-5 update reservation status / remaining / closed time with VERSION; R-6 moves by
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY (IDX_INV_STOCK_MOVE_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY). Each is READ_WRITE inside the caller's transaction except
R-2, R-3 and R-6 (READ_ONLY), with no join.
<!-- SUB:SVC-API-INT:END -->
<!-- PHASE:SVC-API:END -->

## DOC — API documentation

- **The API document** is `api-spec-inv.yaml` (OpenAPI 3.1.0), derived in this stage from the 51 `API-*` blocks
  and the Error Catalog: one operation per block (`operationId` = the block's operation, `x-api-id` = its id,
  `x-traces` = its traces), the request / response schemas from its Request / Response lines (field types from
  the DBF types via CORE R1), one error response per catalog row naming the block (`x-error-codes`), paging
  `page` / `size` with `x-paginated: true`, bearer JWT on every operation. The four in-process-only codes of §5.1
  sit under the document-level `x-inprocess-error-codes`. The frontend binds to this document and mocks it; the
  test stage cites it.
- **The delivered backend** publishes its api-docs with springdoc as the group `inv` (paths `/api/v1/inv/**`);
  each controller method carries `@Operation(operationId = …, summary = <block heading>)`, `@ApiResponse` per
  catalog status, and the `x-api-id` extension, so `api-verify` can hold the published document to
  `api-spec-inv.yaml` operation by operation.
- **In-process surface.** `InventoryApi` carries Javadoc per method naming the contract item it honours
  (CON-INV-006 … 019) and the error codes it can throw; the two events carry their payload description
  (CON-INV-020, 021).
- **Error texts.** The message bundle (`messages_ar.properties`, `messages_en.properties`) keys every code of
  §5 / §5.1 to its texts verbatim; downstream documents cite codes, never the text.
<!-- PHASE:DOC:END -->

## SEC-BE — security (backend half)

Security model: one `SEC_PAGES` row per composite screen, registered by `InvPermissions`
(PermissionContributor, permission module `INV`); the security module derives `PERM_<PAGE_CODE>_<ACTION>` for
VIEW / CREATE / UPDATE / DELETE, VIEW being the gateway. Every endpoint verifies its permission before any
processing (`@PreAuthorize` with the `InvPermissions` constant); a refusal answers INV-403 through
`LocalizedException → {code, messageAr, messageEn}` (REQ-INV-138). No service checks a role name. The
in-process `InventoryApi` checks no INV permission: the calling module authorises its own caller (SRS access
summary).

| Page code | Name ar / en | Parent | Screen |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV_WAREHOUSES | المستودعات / Warehouses | Inventory → Setup | SCR-REQ-INV-001 |
| INV_BRANCHES | الفروع / Branches | Inventory → Setup | SCR-REQ-INV-002 |
| INV_STOCK_BALANCES | أرصدة المخزون / Stock balances | Inventory | SCR-REQ-INV-003 |
| INV_STOCK_MOVES | سجل حركات المخزون / Stock move history | Inventory | SCR-REQ-INV-004 |
| INV_TRANSFERS | التحويلات بين المستودعات / Transfers | Inventory | SCR-REQ-INV-005 |
| INV_COUNTS | جرد المخزون / Stock counts | Inventory | SCR-REQ-INV-006 |
| INV_ADJUSTMENTS | تسويات المخزون / Stock adjustments | Inventory | SCR-REQ-INV-007 |
| INV_LOTS | التشغيلات وقرب انتهاء الصلاحية / Lots and near expiry | Inventory | SCR-REQ-INV-008 |
| INV_ITEM_STOCK_SETTINGS | إعدادات مخزون الصنف / Item stock settings | Inventory → Setup | SCR-REQ-INV-009 |
| INV_OPENING_STOCK | المخزون الافتتاحي / Opening stock | Inventory → Setup | SCR-REQ-INV-010 |
| INV_SETTINGS | إعدادات المخزون / Inventory settings | Inventory → Setup | SCR-REQ-INV-011 |
| INV_STOCK_VALUATION | تقييم المخزون / Stock valuation | Inventory | SCR-REQ-INV-012 |

SCR-REQ-INV-011 has no entity of its own (given cu settings); its row names ENT-INV-004, whose moves the
negative-stock setting governs (REQ-INV-065). Role-preset grants (SRS B4 / access summary — REQ-INV-136, 137):

| Role preset | Permissions granted |
|---|---|
| Owner | all 32 permissions below |
| Warehouse | PERM_INV_WAREHOUSES_VIEW, PERM_INV_BRANCHES_VIEW, PERM_INV_STOCK_BALANCES_VIEW, PERM_INV_STOCK_MOVES_VIEW, PERM_INV_TRANSFERS_VIEW / _CREATE / _UPDATE / _DELETE, PERM_INV_COUNTS_VIEW / _CREATE / _UPDATE / _DELETE, PERM_INV_ADJUSTMENTS_VIEW / _CREATE / _UPDATE / _DELETE, PERM_INV_LOTS_VIEW, PERM_INV_ITEM_STOCK_SETTINGS_VIEW |
| Seller/Cashier | PERM_INV_STOCK_BALANCES_VIEW |

## ALIGN-BE — alignment self-check

Each row's mark is the `gov.py analyze` result for its backing check, copied by the orchestrator from the
report; this stage does not adjudicate them.

```
ALIGN — INV v1
row               backing check        assertion                                                                 mark
TRACEABILITY      traces               every PHASE/SUB/atom block carries traces=, and every API traces to its REQ and its DBF   (report)
COVERED           orphans              every REQ is covered by ≥1 API or DBF                                      (report)
BINDING (§2A)     value-agreement      every DBF names the same physical column here as the db-script declares   (report)
MANIFEST (§4)     count-agrees         every total this plan states equals the rows it heads                      (report)
WRITERS           required-writer      every required column is written by an endpoint, or the row states why not (report)
QRC (§5)          orphans              every catalogued query is reached by ≥1 API                                (report)
API (R3)          code-format          every catalog code is an instance of the declared format with a platform status (report)
API DOCUMENT      api-spec-agree       every API block is one operation of api-spec-inv.yaml and every operation one block (report)
ERROR RESPONSES   api-spec-errors      every catalog row is answered by an operation with its status and code     (report)
DOCUMENT VALID    api-spec-valid       api-spec-inv.yaml validates against OPENAPI 3.1.0 and reaches every required item (report)
RULE INPUTS       data-source          every RULE enforced at runtime names where the data it READS comes from    (report)
CROSS-MODULE      registry-agree       every registered XM is placed here, and every XM minted here is back-registered (report)
INTEGRATION       xm-block-complete    every edge is one complete block of the last phase                         (report)
FOREIGN IDS       xref-resolve         every id of another module cited here is defined in that module's registry (report)
BOOTSTRAP         bootstrap-complete   every lookup key and every permission has a row naming who produces it     (report)
SECURITY (R5)     operation-resolves   every declared entity operation resolves to an API, and every marked matrix cell names its API and permission (report)
DEMAND (SRS)      operation-resolves   every operation an SRS screen names is built by an API, or the plan states why not (report)
DECISIONS         refs-exist           every ADR this plan cites exists on disk in analysis/decisions/INV/        (report)
PATHS             paths-resolve        every path the generated manifest and execution state emit resolves        (report)
COVERAGE          (the report)         the clauses the analyze report lists as having examined nothing            (report)
```

## INT-C — integration (one block per edge)

The one place this plan speaks about another module. Every edge targets CAT (the catalogue module, DAG #1 —
downward from INV, DAG #3). Access is in-process (conventions.module_interface: in_process): CAT's published
crossmodule API is an injected bean — there is no HTTP client, base path, timeout or network error path.
Foreign keys reference the target's primary-key column only (ADR-INV-023); the executor checks the target table
and key column against CAT's delivered migration before running a patch. Each block is one package
(`integration/XM-INV-0nn`).

### XM-INV-012 — Bundle component read
target     : CAT · ENT-CAT-007
type       : SOFT-READ
contract   : contract-cat.md#CON-CAT-006
requires   : CAT:DELIVERED
do         :
  ddl_patch : none — SOFT-READ, no column and no constraint
  adapter   : `com.erp.inv.integration.cat.CatalogBundleComponentAdapter implements BundleComponentPort` — injects CAT's published in-process crossmodule API (the bean exposing CON-CAT-007 / CON-CAT-008). `List<BundleComponent> activeComponents(long bundleVariantPk)`: getVariant(bundleVariantPk) (CON-CAT-008) → itemFk; getItem(itemFk) (CON-CAT-007) → itemKindCode; not BUNDLE → empty list with `isBundle = false`; BUNDLE → its Bundle component lines mapped to {componentVariantPk = componentVariantFk, quantity (3 dp, in the component Item's base unit — CON-CAT-006), componentBaseUomCode}; a line whose component Variant reads inactive through getVariant is dropped; CAT "not found" → INV-404-VARIANT-NOT-FOUND. The callers multiply the bundle quantity by `quantity` (REQ-INV-042 availability, 049 reservation, 053 issue) and raise INV-422-BUNDLE-NO-COMPONENTS on an empty list of a bundle (RULE-INV-022)
  config    : Spring `@Component` in package com.erp.inv.integration.cat, the only `BundleComponentPort` bean; in-process call inside the caller's transaction — no HTTP client, no base path, no timeout
tests      : AC-INV-047, AC-INV-054, AC-INV-059, AC-INV-060
if_not_met : skip-block; record in execution-state.json → deferred_xm; continue
<!-- XM:XM-INV-012:END -->

         _state/current-frontend-execution-plan.md (P3.2) · _state/current-api-spec (api-spec-inv.yaml, OpenAPI 3.1.0)

## How to read this plan

- **Framework.** `profile.stack.testing` is agnostic. Each TC block below is the whole contract. The consumer
  repository chooses its tool and turns each block into one test.
- **Shapes.** Each TC cites the `API-*` it calls. Method, path, request and response schemas, the
  `ApiResponse<T>` envelope, paging and the error responses are read in `api-spec-inv.yaml`; they are not
  restated here.
- **In-process operations.** The contract operations that other modules call (CON-INV-006 … 019) are the injected
  `InventoryApi` bean, with no REST route (ADR-INV-024). Their TCs cite the method and the contract item in
  `Exercises` and name the package `SVC-API-INT` (ADR-INV-037).
- **Refusals.** A refusal is asserted as the HTTP status of its catalogue row, `code`, `messageAr` and
  `messageEn`. The texts are copied from the SRS. An in-process refusal is the same `LocalizedException` thrown
  to the caller. "Nothing saved" is checked by reading back through the cited read operation.
- **Clock.** "today" is the tenant's date. A TC that names a date fixes the tenant clock to it.
- **Catalogue data.** Every lookup value a case names is seeded by INV (SRS A6 `seeded`). No case needs host
  data. Unit-of-measure values (metre, KG) belong to CAT's consumed lookup and are preconditions of the CAT
  catalogue, not INV data.

### TC-INV-001 — A second warehouse with a taken Arabic name is refused
Derived from : AC-INV-004  (REQ-INV-003)
Exercises    : API-INV-003 POST /api/v1/inv/warehouses · read back API-INV-001 GET /api/v1/inv/warehouses
Rule / code  : RULE-INV-002 → INV-409-WAREHOUSE-NAME-TAKEN
Package      : SVC-API-CRUD
Scenario     : VIOLATION · data class INVALID · language ALL
Preconditions: Owner session; an active Warehouse with nameAr «مستودع الفرع»
Host data    : none
Steps        : 1. POST a new warehouse with nameAr «مستودع الفرع». 2. GET the warehouses with name «مستودع الفرع», active ALL.
Expected     : 1 → 409, code INV-409-WAREHOUSE-NAME-TAKEN, messageAr «يوجد مستودع آخر بهذا الاسم.», messageEn "Another warehouse already has this name.". 2 → exactly 1 Warehouse carries that name (nothing saved).
Test data    : nameAr «مستودع الفرع»
<!-- TC:TC-INV-001:END -->

<!-- TC:TC-INV-002:START traces=AC-INV-007,REQ-INV-006,API-INV-005,API-INV-002 -->

Expected     : 1 → 409, code INV-409-WAREHOUSE-DEFAULT, messageAr «لا يمكن إيقاف المستودع الافتراضي. اجعل مستودعًا آخر افتراضيًا أولًا.», messageEn "The default warehouse cannot be deactivated. Set another warehouse as the default first.". 2 → D has isActiveFl true and isDefaultFl true.
Test data    : D = the tenant's default warehouse

## INT-XM — integration test cases (this module's edges)

Source: the 15 `XM-*` blocks of INT-C in the backend plan (cross-checked against registry-db: 11 HARD-FK, 4
SOFT-READ, all to CAT). Each block's `requires` is CAT:DELIVERED. A HARD-FK yields an EXISTS case and a
MISSING case. In both, the block's migration has run, so its constraint exists, and its pre-check query (orphan
count) returns 0. A SOFT-READ yields one GRACEFUL-DEGRADATION case. Each case exercises INV's own surface; the
CAT entity is cited by id only. When `requires` is not met, the block's `if_not_met` path applies (skip-block,
recorded in execution-state.json → deferred_xm) and its cases are not run.

<<<ARTIFACT: current-business-policies.md>>>
## BUSINESS POLICIES — Inventory / المخزون (INV)
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Module   : INV     Source of truth : user vision text + dialogue resolutions
Read by  : P0.5 (every user story cites the policies it serves)
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

CLIENT-SPECIFIC POLICIES   (only from user text or confirmed dialogue answers)

POL-INV-001 — One stock across channels / مخزون واحد لجميع القنوات
  Statement : The system shall keep a single stock per warehouse that back-office documents, the point of sale and the storefront all draw from.
  Statement (ar) : يجب على النظام أن يحتفظ بمخزون واحد لكل مستودع تسحب منه مستندات المكتب الخلفي ونقطة البيع والمتجر الإلكتروني جميعًا.
  Pattern   : ubiquitous
  Trigger   : Stock move (any channel)
  Rationale : The product promise is one catalogue, one stock and one customer base across back-office, POS and storefront.
  Source    : KB:raw-idea.md §1 "one catalogue, one stock, one customer base"
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-002 — Warehouse on every stock move / المستودع في كل حركة مخزون
  Statement : The system shall record the warehouse on every stock move, including while the tenant has only one warehouse.
  Statement (ar) : يجب على النظام أن يسجّل المستودع في كل حركة مخزون، حتى عندما يكون لدى المستأجر مستودع واحد فقط.
  Pattern   : ubiquitous
  Trigger   : Create (stock move)
  Rationale : A second warehouse can be added later without data migration.
  Source    : KB:raw-idea.md §6.8 "every stock move carries warehouse_id"; DP §5 G8
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-003 — Default warehouse at start / مستودع افتراضي عند البدء
  Statement : When a tenant is provisioned, the system shall create one default warehouse so that stock can be received without any warehouse setup.
  Statement (ar) : عند إنشاء مستأجر جديد، يجب على النظام أن ينشئ مستودعًا افتراضيًا واحدًا بحيث يمكن استلام المخزون دون أي إعداد للمستودعات.
  Pattern   : event
  Trigger   : Tenant provisioning
  Rationale : The platform starts with one warehouse and nothing is imposed on the user.
  Source    : KB:raw-idea.md §6.8 "one warehouse/branch/currency/price list to start"; DP §5 G8
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-004 — Hidden warehouse selector while one warehouse / إخفاء محدد المستودع عند وجود مستودع واحد
  Statement : While the tenant has exactly one active warehouse, the system shall hide the warehouse selector, the inter-warehouse transfer action and the warehouse report filters.
  Statement (ar) : أثناء امتلاك المستأجر مستودعًا نشطًا واحدًا فقط، يجب على النظام أن يخفي محدد المستودع وإجراء التحويل بين المستودعات ومرشحات المستودع في التقارير.
  Pattern   : state
  Trigger   : View (any inventory screen or report)
  Rationale : Only what is meaningful is shown, with no dead menus.
  Source    : KB:raw-idea.md §6.3, §6.8; DP §5 G8
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-005 — Reveal on second warehouse / الإظهار عند إضافة مستودع ثانٍ
  Statement : When a second warehouse is added, the system shall reveal the warehouse selector, the inter-warehouse transfer action and the warehouse report filters without data migration or re-setup.
  Statement (ar) : عند إضافة مستودع ثانٍ، يجب على النظام أن يُظهر محدد المستودع وإجراء التحويل بين المستودعات ومرشحات المستودع في التقارير دون ترحيل للبيانات ودون إعادة إعداد.
  Pattern   : event
  Trigger   : Create (warehouse)
  Rationale : Multi-warehouse appears automatically when the business grows.
  Source    : KB:raw-idea.md §6.8 "reveals it — plus the related actions (e.g. inter-warehouse transfer) and report filters — automatically"
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-006 — Lot and expiry on receipt / التشغيلة والصلاحية عند الاستلام
  Statement : Where the lotExpiry capability flag is on, the system shall capture a lot and its expiry date on every stock receipt of an item tracked by lot.
  Statement (ar) : حيثما كان مفتاح القدرة lotExpiry مفعّلًا، يجب على النظام أن يسجّل التشغيلة وتاريخ صلاحيتها في كل استلام مخزون لصنف يُتتبَّع بالتشغيلة.
  Pattern   : optional
  Trigger   : Receive (stock receipt)
  Rationale : Grocery, cleaning-supplies, feed and produce presets need lot and expiry.
  Source    : KB:raw-idea.md §4.1 (`lotExpiry`: "lot + expiry on receipt"), §4.2
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-007 — FEFO issue / الصرف بالأقرب انتهاءً
  Statement : Where the lotExpiry capability flag is on, the system shall issue stock of items tracked by lot first-expiry-first-out (FEFO).
  Statement (ar) : حيثما كان مفتاح القدرة lotExpiry مفعّلًا، يجب على النظام أن يصرف مخزون الأصناف المتتبَّعة بالتشغيلة وفق مبدأ الأقرب انتهاءً يُصرف أولًا (FEFO).
  Pattern   : optional
  Trigger   : Issue (stock issue)
  Rationale : Stock nearest to expiry leaves first, which reduces write-offs.
  Source    : KB:raw-idea.md §4.1 (`lotExpiry`: "FEFO issue")
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-008 — Near-expiry reporting / تقرير قرب انتهاء الصلاحية
  Statement : Where the lotExpiry capability flag is on, the system shall report the stock that is approaching its expiry date.
  Statement (ar) : حيثما كان مفتاح القدرة lotExpiry مفعّلًا، يجب على النظام أن يقدّم تقريرًا بالمخزون الذي يقترب من تاريخ انتهاء صلاحيته.
  Pattern   : optional
  Trigger   : Report
  Rationale : Traders act on stock close to expiry before it is lost.
  Source    : KB:raw-idea.md §4.1 (`lotExpiry`: "near-expiry reports")
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-009 — Dual quantity stock / مخزون بالكمية المزدوجة
  Statement : Where the dualQuantity capability flag is on, the system shall track the stock of dual-quantity items in both a count and a measure of weight or length.
  Statement (ar) : حيثما كان مفتاح القدرة dualQuantity مفعّلًا، يجب على النظام أن يتتبّع مخزون الأصناف ذات الكمية المزدوجة بالعدد وبالقياس (الوزن أو الطول) معًا.
  Pattern   : optional
  Trigger   : Stock move (any)
  Rationale : Fabrics (metre), building materials and steel, and produce or meat by weight are stocked in two quantities.
  Source    : KB:raw-idea.md §4.1 (`dualQuantity`: "count + weight/length"), §4.2
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-010 — Flag turn-off blocked when data depends on it / منع إيقاف المفتاح عند وجود بيانات تعتمد عليه
  Statement : If a user turns off the lotExpiry or dualQuantity capability flag and stock data depends on it, then the system shall block the change and show which data depends on it.
  Statement (ar) : إذا أوقف مستخدم مفتاح القدرة lotExpiry أو dualQuantity وكانت بيانات مخزون تعتمد عليه، فيجب على النظام أن يمنع التغيير وأن يبيّن البيانات التي تعتمد عليه.
  Pattern   : unwanted
  Trigger   : Update (capability flag)
  Rationale : A flag may be turned on at any time, but never off when data depends on it, and no error is a dead end.
  Source    : KB:raw-idea.md §6.2, §6.5; DP §5 G3
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-011 — Flags only, never the activity / المفاتيح فقط وليس النشاط
  Statement : The system shall vary inventory behaviour only by capability flags and never by the tenant's declared activity.
  Statement (ar) : يجب على النظام أن يغيّر سلوك المخزون وفق مفاتيح القدرة فقط، وألّا يعتمد أبدًا على النشاط التجاري المعلن للمستأجر.
  Pattern   : ubiquitous
  Trigger   : Any inventory operation
  Rationale : One codebase serves every activity. The activity is only a preset that sets flags.
  Source    : KB:raw-idea.md §3 D2, §7; DP §5 G1
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-012 — Mobile stock counting / الجرد عبر الهاتف المحمول
  Statement : The system shall let a user perform a stock count from a mobile-sized responsive web screen.
  Statement (ar) : يجب على النظام أن يتيح للمستخدم إجراء جرد المخزون من شاشة ويب متجاوبة بحجم الهاتف المحمول.
  Pattern   : ubiquitous
  Trigger   : Count (stock count)
  Rationale : Counting is a mobile-first activity, and there is no native app in v1.
  Source    : KB:raw-idea.md §6.7 "Mobile-first for selling, collecting, counting", §9
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-013 — Warehouse role preset / الدور المسبق «المستودع»
  Statement : The system shall provide a Warehouse role preset that grants access to the inventory functions.
  Statement (ar) : يجب على النظام أن يوفّر دورًا مسبق الإعداد باسم «المستودع» يمنح الوصول إلى وظائف المخزون.
  Pattern   : ubiquitous
  Trigger   : Tenant provisioning / role assignment
  Rationale : Three role presets (Owner, Seller/Cashier, Warehouse) let a new tenant start without designing roles.
  Source    : KB:raw-idea.md §3 D8; registry §2.4 D8
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-014 — Bundle issue moves component stock / صرف الحزمة يحرّك مخزون مكوّناتها
  Statement : Where the bundles capability flag is on, the system shall issue the stock of a bundle by moving the stock of its component items.
  Statement (ar) : حيثما كان مفتاح القدرة bundles مفعّلًا، يجب على النظام أن يصرف مخزون الحزمة بتحريك مخزون الأصناف المكوِّنة لها.
  Pattern   : optional
  Trigger   : Issue (bundle)
  Rationale : A bundle holds no stock of its own, so its availability always follows its components and no assembly step is needed.
  Source    : Dialogue resolution INV-P06; KB:raw-idea.md §4.1 (`bundles`), §3 D1, §9
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-015 — Default branch at start / فرع افتراضي عند البدء
  Statement : When a tenant is provisioned, the system shall create one default branch so that documents can be issued without any branch setup.
  Statement (ar) : عند إنشاء مستأجر جديد، يجب على النظام أن ينشئ فرعًا افتراضيًا واحدًا بحيث يمكن إصدار المستندات دون أي إعداد للفروع.
  Pattern   : event
  Trigger   : Tenant provisioning
  Rationale : The platform starts with one branch and nothing is imposed on the user.
  Source    : Dialogue resolution INV-P07; KB:raw-idea.md §6.8 "one warehouse/branch/currency/price list to start"; DP §5 G8
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-016 — Hidden branch selector while one branch / إخفاء محدد الفرع عند وجود فرع واحد
  Statement : While the tenant has exactly one active branch, the system shall hide the branch selector and the branch report filters.
  Statement (ar) : أثناء امتلاك المستأجر فرعًا نشطًا واحدًا فقط، يجب على النظام أن يخفي محدد الفرع ومرشحات الفرع في التقارير.
  Pattern   : state
  Trigger   : View (any screen or report with a branch)
  Rationale : Only what is meaningful is shown, with no dead menus.
  Source    : Dialogue resolution INV-P07; KB:raw-idea.md §6.3, §6.8; DP §5 G8
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-017 — Reveal on second branch / الإظهار عند إضافة فرع ثانٍ
  Statement : When a second branch is added, the system shall reveal the branch selector and the branch report filters without data migration or re-setup.
  Statement (ar) : عند إضافة فرع ثانٍ، يجب على النظام أن يُظهر محدد الفرع ومرشحات الفرع في التقارير دون ترحيل للبيانات ودون إعادة إعداد.
  Pattern   : event
  Trigger   : Create (branch)
  Rationale : Multi-branch appears automatically when the business grows.
  Source    : Dialogue resolution INV-P07; KB:raw-idea.md §6.8 "reveals it … automatically"
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-018 — Optional block on negative stock / منع الرصيد السالب اختياريًا
  Statement : Where the tenant disallows negative stock, the system shall block an online stock issue that would take a warehouse balance below zero.
  Statement (ar) : حيثما منع المستأجر الرصيد السالب، يجب على النظام أن يحظر أي صرف مخزون متصل بالإنترنت يؤدي إلى هبوط رصيد المستودع دون الصفر.
  Pattern   : optional
  Trigger   : Issue (online stock issue)
  Rationale : A tenant that wants strict balances can switch blocking on; the default allows negative stock so that a new owner is never stopped before opening stock is loaded.
  Source    : Dialogue resolution INV-P08; KB:raw-idea.md §6.5, §6.10; DP §5 G7
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-019 — Alert on negative stock / تنبيه عند الرصيد السالب
  Statement : If a stock issue takes a warehouse balance below zero, then the system shall alert the Warehouse role.
  Statement (ar) : إذا أدّى صرف مخزون إلى هبوط رصيد مستودع دون الصفر، فيجب على النظام أن ينبّه دور «المستودع».
  Pattern   : unwanted
  Trigger   : Issue (stock issue)
  Rationale : A negative balance is allowed but never silent.
  Source    : Dialogue resolution INV-P08; KB:raw-idea.md §6.5
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-020 — Offline POS sales always accepted / قبول مبيعات نقطة البيع دون اتصال دائمًا
  Statement : If a synchronised offline point-of-sale sale takes a warehouse balance below zero, then the system shall accept the sale.
  Statement (ar) : إذا أدّى بيع من نقطة البيع نُفّذ دون اتصال ثم تمت مزامنته إلى هبوط رصيد مستودع دون الصفر، فيجب على النظام أن يقبل عملية البيع.
  Pattern   : unwanted
  Trigger   : Synchronise (offline sale)
  Rationale : The goods have already left, so rejecting the sale would lose a real transaction.
  Source    : Dialogue resolution INV-P08; KB:raw-idea.md §5 #6 (POS offline-capable)
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-021 — Weighted-average stock valuation / تقييم المخزون بالتكلفة المتوسطة المرجّحة
  Statement : The system shall value stock at the perpetual weighted-average cost of each variant across the tenant.
  Statement (ar) : يجب على النظام أن يقيّم المخزون بالتكلفة المتوسطة المرجّحة المستمرة لكل متغيّر صنف على مستوى المستأجر.
  Pattern   : ubiquitous
  Trigger   : Receive / Issue (stock move)
  Rationale : Weighted average is permitted by the accounting standards, is the simplest for a small trader and stays stable when stock moves between warehouses.
  Source    : Dialogue resolution INV-P09; IAS 2 ¶25 (not live-verified)
  Status    : CONFIRMED

POL-INV-022 — Expired lots excluded from sale / استبعاد التشغيلات المنتهية من البيع
  Statement : If a lot has passed its expiry date, then the system shall exclude it from issue for sale.
  Statement (ar) : إذا تجاوزت تشغيلة تاريخ صلاحيتها، فيجب على النظام أن يستبعدها من الصرف للبيع.
  Pattern   : unwanted
  Trigger   : Issue (sale)
  Rationale : Selling expired goods is prohibited; the lot stays in stock until a stock adjustment writes it off.
  Source    : Dialogue resolution INV-P10; KB:raw-idea.md §4.1, §4.2; consumer-protection practice (not live-verified)
  Status    : CONFIRMED

CUSTOM LOOKUP VALUES   (values the user named that the standard lists lack)
None — standard values apply.

SCOPE EXCEPTIONS   (explicit exclusions or non-standard scope)
| Excluded / Deferred | Statement | Activation trigger | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bundle assembly and disassembly (stock of pre-built bundles) / تجميع الحزم وتفكيكها | Assembly orders are light manufacturing, which is excluded. Bundles are exploded into component stock moves | A later version that admits manufacturing scope | KB §3 D1, §9; dialogue INV-P06 |
| Native mobile counting app / تطبيق جرد أصلي للهاتف | Counting runs on responsive web only in v1 | A version that admits native apps | KB §6.7, §9 |
| FIFO cost layers / طبقات التكلفة بالوارد أولًا | v1 values stock at weighted-average cost only | A later version, if a customer requires FIFO | dialogue INV-P09 |

Adds POL-INV-018, POL-INV-019, POL-INV-020 | Converged in dialogue (round 2); user confirms at the gate | KB §5 #6, §6.5, §6.10; DP §5 G7 |

# CONTRACT — Inventory / المخزون (INV) — outbound promise
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Module : INV   Version : v1   Profile : commerce   Stage : P1.5
Inputs : srs-inv.md (P1 pass 1, round 1), registry-srs (P1 — INV v1)
Counts : CON 21 (ENTITY 5 · OPERATION 16) · ADR 0 (next free ADR-INV-014)
Status : DRAFT — P1.5 pass 1, round 1 · prepared by claude:opus
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

## 0 — Reading this contract

- This is what other modules may depend on before INV is built: the SHARED entities they
  reference and the operations and events they call or receive. It promises; it never
  implements. The INV backend plan (P3.1) chooses paths and verbs and states
  `Honours: CON-INV-…` on the block that implements each item.
- An item with a `Signature` line is an operation (or a published event); an item without one
  is an entity promise.
- **Identifiers.** Every INV entity identifier is a `BIGINT` identity key assigned by the
  database (stack.db.pk_generation = identity). A consumer's HARD-FK column to an INV entity is
  `BIGINT` — copied verbatim, no other identifier type exists in v1.
- **Not promised (private):** Stock move (ENT-INV-004 — published only as the event of
  CON-INV-020), Reservation (ENT-INV-005 — reached only through CON-INV-011 … 013, 015),
  Transfer and its lines (ENT-INV-006, 007), Stock count and its lines (ENT-INV-008, 009),
  Stock adjustment and its lines (ENT-INV-010, 011), Item stock settings (ENT-INV-014 — read
  only through CON-INV-018). No table, column list beyond key columns, or endpoint path is
  promised.
- **Conventions binding every operation (from the SRS):**
  - Calls are in-process (`crossmodule` APIs); the calling module authorises its own caller;
    tenancy applies to every call (SRS Access summary).
  - Quantities are in the Item's base unit (CON-CAT-001 `baseUomCode`); the caller converts
    other units first (SRS D-05). Quantity and measure: 3 decimals; unit and average cost:
    4 decimals; value: 2 decimals in the tenant base currency (SRS D-06).
  - A warehouse input is optional while the tenant has exactly one active warehouse (the
    default is applied) and required when two or more are active (RULE-INV-008, REQ-INV-013,
    REQ-INV-017).
  - When `variants` is off the caller passes the Item's default Variant (CON-CAT-002); INV
    always keys on a Variant (SRS D-27).
  - Every receipt, issue and reservation request carries a caller-supplied idempotency key
    (text, ≤ 64); a repeated key returns the first result and records nothing new
    (RULE-INV-024, REQ-INV-058). This is not an error.
  - Source documents are passed as type (INV_SOURCE_DOC_TYPE — open lookup; calling modules add
    their document types as data), identifier (BIGINT), number (text ≤ 30) and optional line
    identifier (BIGINT). INV keeps them as SOFT references with no FK (ENT-INV-004.sourceDocRef).
  - Errors are stated by meaning; each carries its RULE's Arabic and English message (SRS A5).
  - Capability flags (`lotExpiry`, `dualQuantity`, `bundles`) are read by INV through the
    FeatureFlags API; behaviour marked "flag on" applies only while the flag is on (REQ-INV-132).

## 1 — ENTITY items

### CON-INV-001 — المستودع / Warehouse (ar / en)

Entity    : ENT-INV-001 — key columns: `code` (business key, series INV_WAREHOUSE, read-only, text 20), `warehousePk` (identifier a consumer stores) · identifier type: BIGINT
Consumers : PUR, SLS, SFR, INS (HARD-FK `BIGINT` → warehousePk)
Promise   : a deactivated Warehouse stays readable by its identifier and is excluded from every
            new selection; consumers are notified through CON-INV-021 and their records are never
            changed (notify, never cascade — RULE-INV-005). Exactly one active default Warehouse
            exists per tenant from provisioning on (REQ-INV-001, RULE-INV-006).
Traces    : ENT-INV-001, REQ-INV-001, REQ-INV-005, REQ-INV-009, REQ-INV-019

### CON-INV-002 — الفرع / Branch (ar / en)

Entity    : ENT-INV-002 — key columns: `code` (business key, series INV_BRANCH, read-only, text 20), `branchPk` (identifier a consumer stores) · identifier type: BIGINT
Consumers : PUR, SLS, STL, TAX, INS (HARD-FK `BIGINT` → branchPk)
Promise   : a deactivated Branch stays readable by its identifier and is excluded from every new
            selection; consumers are notified through CON-INV-021 and their records are never
            changed (RULE-INV-014). Exactly one active default Branch exists per tenant from
            provisioning on (REQ-INV-020, RULE-INV-015). Every Warehouse belongs to a Branch
            (ENT-INV-001.branchFk).
Traces    : ENT-INV-002, REQ-INV-020, REQ-INV-024, REQ-INV-028, REQ-INV-033

### CON-INV-003 — التشغيلة / Lot (ar / en)

Entity    : ENT-INV-012 — key columns: `variantFk` + `code` (business key — the lot number written on the goods, unique per Variant, text 40), `lotPk` (identifier a consumer stores) · identifier type: BIGINT
Consumers : PUR (receipt), SLS (FEFO issue) — flag `lotExpiry` on
Promise   : one lot number of a Variant has one expiry date (RULE-INV-036); a Lot is created by
            INV on the first receipt or increase that names it (REQ-INV-106) — consumers never
            create a Lot directly. A Lot whose expiry date is before today (tenant time zone) is
            never sold (RULE-INV-038).
Traces    : ENT-INV-012, REQ-INV-106, REQ-INV-109, REQ-INV-113

### CON-INV-004 — رصيد المخزون / Stock balance (ar / en)

Entity    : ENT-INV-003 — key columns: `variantFk` + `warehouseFk` + `lotFk` (business key — one record per Variant × warehouse × lot, lot empty for stock without a lot), `stockBalancePk` (identifier) · identifier type: BIGINT
Consumers : SLS, SFR, INS (read through CON-INV-010; no consumer stores stockBalancePk)
Promise   : one stock for every channel (REQ-INV-035); maintained only by stock moves, never
            written by another module. Reserved and available quantities are derived at read time
            (REQ-INV-038).
Traces    : ENT-INV-003, REQ-INV-035, REQ-INV-038, REQ-INV-040

### CON-INV-005 — تقييم المخزون / Stock valuation (ar / en)

Entity    : ENT-INV-013 — key columns: `variantFk` (business key — one record per Variant across the tenant), `stockValuationPk` (identifier) · identifier type: BIGINT
Consumers : SLS (margin), INS (read through CON-INV-016); ACC receives costs through CON-INV-020
Promise   : perpetual weighted-average cost per Variant across the tenant (REQ-INV-059 …
            REQ-INV-062); maintained only by stock moves.
Traces    : ENT-INV-013, REQ-INV-059, REQ-INV-063

## 2 — OPERATION items

### CON-INV-006 — قراءة مستودع / Read a warehouse (ar / en)
Signature : readWarehouse(warehousePk: BIGINT) → Warehouse {warehousePk, code, nameAr, nameEn, branchPk, isDefaultFl, isActiveFl} · errors: not found
Entity    : ENT-INV-001
Notes     : returns inactive Warehouses too (RULE-INV-005).
Traces    : REQ-INV-009, REQ-INV-005

### CON-INV-007 — المستودعات النشطة / List the active warehouses (ar / en)
Signature : listActiveWarehouses() → {activeCount, warehouses: [{warehousePk, code, nameAr, nameEn, branchPk, isDefaultFl}]} · errors: none
Entity    : ENT-INV-001
Notes     : consumers hide their own warehouse selector while activeCount is 1 (POL-INV-004).
Traces    : REQ-INV-019

### CON-INV-008 — قراءة فرع / Read a branch (ar / en)
Signature : readBranch(branchPk: BIGINT) → Branch {branchPk, code, nameAr, nameEn, isDefaultFl, isActiveFl} · errors: not found
Entity    : ENT-INV-002
Notes     : returns inactive Branches too (RULE-INV-014).
Traces    : REQ-INV-028, REQ-INV-024

### CON-INV-009 — الفروع النشطة / List the active branches (ar / en)
Signature : listActiveBranches() → {activeCount, branches: [{branchPk, code, nameAr, nameEn, isDefaultFl}]} · errors: none
Entity    : ENT-INV-002
Notes     : consumers hide their own branch selector while activeCount is 1 (POL-INV-016).
Traces    : REQ-INV-033

### CON-INV-010 — توفّر متغيّر الصنف / Read the availability of a Variant (ar / en)
Signature : readAvailability(variantPk: BIGINT, warehousePk?: BIGINT) → {perWarehouse: [{warehousePk, onHandQty, reservedQty, availableQty, onHandMeasureQty?, measureUomCode?}], total: {onHandQty, reservedQty, availableQty, onHandMeasureQty?}} · errors: Variant not found
Entity    : ENT-INV-003
Notes     : per active warehouse and in total. Available = on-hand outside expired lots minus
            ACTIVE reservations (RULE-INV-038). A Variant that never moved answers zeros, not an
            error (REQ-INV-041). Flag `bundles` on: a bundle Variant answers the derived
            availability of its components (REQ-INV-042). Flag `dualQuantity` on: measure and its
            unit for dual-quantity Items (REQ-INV-121).
Traces    : REQ-INV-040, REQ-INV-041, REQ-INV-042, REQ-INV-121

### CON-INV-011 — حجز مخزون / Reserve stock (ar / en)
Signature : reserve(variantPk: BIGINT, warehousePk?: BIGINT, quantity, sourceDoc {typeCode, ref, no, lineRef?}, idempotencyKey) → {reservations: [{reservationPk: BIGINT, variantPk, warehousePk, statusCode, originalQty, reservedQty, shortfallQty, bundleVariantPk?}]} · errors: warehouse required, warehouse inactive, Variant inactive, invalid quantity, not enough available (negative stock disallowed), bundle without active components
Entity    : ENT-INV-003
Notes     : while negative stock is allowed (tenant default) a request beyond availability is
            accepted with its shortfall recorded; the caller decides what to do with it
            (REQ-INV-045, SRS D-11). Flag `bundles` on: a bundle is reserved as one Reservation per
            component (REQ-INV-049). The caller keeps reservationPk as a SOFT reference (no FK) to
            release or consume it; the Reservation itself is private. Reservations do not expire
            automatically in v1 — the owning module releases them (SRS D-24).
            RULE-INV-007, 008, 017, 018, 020, 022, 024.
Traces    : REQ-INV-043, REQ-INV-044, REQ-INV-045, REQ-INV-049

### CON-INV-012 — تحرير حجز / Release a reservation (ar / en)
Signature : releaseReservation(reservationPk: BIGINT) → {reservationPk, statusCode RELEASED, reservedQty 0, closedAt} · errors: not found, reservation closed
Entity    : ENT-INV-003
Notes     : only an ACTIVE reservation is released (RULE-INV-021); availability rises at once.
Traces    : REQ-INV-046, REQ-INV-048

### CON-INV-013 — حجوزات مستند / Read the reservations of a source document (ar / en)
Signature : reservationsOfDocument(sourceDocTypeCode, sourceDocRef: BIGINT) → [{reservationPk, variantPk, warehousePk, statusCode, reservedQty, shortfallQty, bundleVariantPk?}] · errors: none (empty list when none)
Entity    : ENT-INV-003
Traces    : REQ-INV-050

### CON-INV-014 — استلام مخزون / Receive stock (ar / en)
Signature : receiveStock(warehousePk?: BIGINT, moveTypeCode RECEIPT | RETURN_IN, lines: [{variantPk, quantity, unitCost?, lotNo?, lotExpiryDate?, measureQty?, sourceLineRef?}], sourceDoc {typeCode, ref, no}, idempotencyKey) → {moves: [{stockMovePk: BIGINT, variantPk, warehousePk, lotPk?, quantity, measureQty?, unitCost, moveValue}]} · errors: warehouse required, warehouse inactive, Variant inactive or of a BUNDLE Item, invalid quantity, no known cost, lot number and expiry required, lot recorded with a different expiry, measure required
Entity    : ENT-INV-003
Notes     : one move per line at the line's unit cost; a line without a cost takes the current
            average and is refused when the Variant was never valued (RULE-INV-025). Each receipt
            recalculates the weighted-average cost (REQ-INV-059). All lines are recorded or none.
            Flag `lotExpiry` on: lot-tracked Items require lot number and expiry; the Lot is reused
            or created (REQ-INV-105, REQ-INV-106). Flag `dualQuantity` on: dual-quantity Items
            require the measure (REQ-INV-120). Whether an Item needs a lot or a measure is read
            beforehand through CON-INV-018. RULE-INV-007, 008, 017, 018, 024, 025, 035, 036, 040.
Traces    : REQ-INV-051, REQ-INV-064, REQ-INV-105, REQ-INV-106, REQ-INV-107, REQ-INV-120

### CON-INV-015 — صرف مخزون / Issue stock (ar / en)
Signature : issueStock(warehousePk?: BIGINT, moveTypeCode ISSUE | RETURN_OUT, saleFl, offlineFl, lines: [{variantPk, quantity, lotPk? (non-sale only), measureQty?, reservationPk?, sourceLineRef?}], sourceDoc {typeCode, ref, no}, idempotencyKey) → {moves: [{stockMovePk: BIGINT, variantPk, warehousePk, lotPk?, quantity, measureQty?, unitCost, moveValue, bundleVariantPk?}]} · errors: warehouse required, warehouse inactive, Variant inactive, invalid quantity, not enough stock (online, negative stock disallowed), reservation closed, bundle without active components, lot expired, measure required
Entity    : ENT-INV-003
Notes     : moves are valued at the Variant's current average cost (REQ-INV-061). An issue that
            references a reservation consumes it (REQ-INV-047). A synchronised offline POS sale
            (offlineFl true) is always recorded, whatever the negative-stock setting
            (REQ-INV-069). Flag `bundles` on: a bundle is issued as one move per component and
            none for the bundle itself (REQ-INV-053). Flag `lotExpiry` on: a sale issue draws stock
            without a lot first, then unexpired lots by nearest expiry, and posts any uncovered
            quantity without a lot (REQ-INV-110 … 113); a non-sale issue or return to supplier
            naming an expired lot is refused (REQ-INV-114). One answer may therefore carry several
            moves per line. All lines are recorded or none.
            RULE-INV-007, 008, 017, 018, 019, 021, 022, 024, 038, 039, 040.
Traces    : REQ-INV-052, REQ-INV-053, REQ-INV-067, REQ-INV-069, REQ-INV-110, REQ-INV-111, REQ-INV-114

### CON-INV-016 — قراءة التقييم / Read the valuation of a Variant (ar / en)
Signature : readValuation(variantPk: BIGINT) → {variantPk, totalOnHandQty, averageUnitCost, stockValue} · errors: Variant not found
Entity    : ENT-INV-013
Notes     : a Variant never valued answers zero quantity and value with no average (consistent
            with REQ-INV-041; the caller treats a missing average as "no known cost").
Traces    : REQ-INV-063

### CON-INV-017 — قراءة تشغيلة / Read a lot (ar / en)
Signature : readLot(lotPk: BIGINT) → Lot {lotPk, variantPk, code, nameAr, nameEn, expiryDate, expiredFl, isActiveFl} · errors: not found
Entity    : ENT-INV-012
Traces    : REQ-INV-109

### CON-INV-018 — إعدادات مخزون الصنف / Read the stock settings of an Item (ar / en)
Signature : readItemStockSettings(itemPk: BIGINT) → {lotTrackedFl, dualQuantityFl, measureUomCode?} · errors: none (false, false, empty when the Item has no record)
Entity    : ENT-INV-014 (read-only answer; the entity itself stays private)
Traces    : REQ-INV-129

### CON-INV-019 — فحص إيقاف مفتاح القدرة / Capability turn-off check (ar / en)
Signature : canTurnOff(flag lotExpiry | dualQuantity) → {allowedFl, dependentCount, dependents: [{itemPk, code, nameAr, nameEn}] (at most 20), messageAr?, messageEn?} · errors: unknown flag
Entity    : ENT-INV-014 (read-only answer)
Notes     : called by the capability-flag owner (P-02); not allowed while any Item depends on the
            flag, with a message naming the next step (RULE-INV-046).
Traces    : REQ-INV-130, REQ-INV-131

### CON-INV-020 — حدث حركة المخزون / Stock-move event (ar / en)
Signature : event StockMoveRecorded {stockMovePk: BIGINT, docDate, moveTypeCode, variantPk, warehousePk, lotPk?, quantity, measureQty?, unitCost, moveValue, sourceDocTypeCode, sourceDocRef, sourceDocNo, sourceLineRef?, bundleVariantPk?, offlineFl} → delivered once per committed move, after commit · errors: none (never delivered when the transaction rolls back)
Entity    : ENT-INV-013 (the cost it carries); the move itself stays private
Notes     : consumers ACC (posting), SWR, INS; stockMovePk lets a consumer process each event
            once. Moves are never changed or deleted (RULE-INV-023), so no correction event exists —
            a correction arrives as a new ADJUSTMENT_IN / ADJUSTMENT_OUT move.
Traces    : REQ-INV-057, REQ-INV-055

### CON-INV-021 — حدث تغيّر بيانات المخزون الأساسية / Inventory master-change event (ar / en)
Signature : event InventoryMasterChanged {entity ENT-INV-001 | ENT-INV-002, identifier: BIGINT, changeKindCode (INV_CHANGE_KIND: CREATED, UPDATED, DEACTIVATED, REACTIVATED, DEFAULT_CHANGED)} → delivered once per committed Warehouse or Branch change, after commit · errors: none (never delivered on rollback)
Entity    : ENT-INV-001, ENT-INV-002
Notes     : consumers PUR, SLS, SFR, STL, TAX, INS refresh selectors and active counts; the event
            notifies and never cascades (ARCH-5).
Traces    : REQ-INV-034

## 2.5 — Given usage (repeated from the SRS)

```yaml name=given-usage
rows:
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.cu, via: com.erp.cu.crossmodule.SettingsApi, purpose: "read the lotExpiry, dualQuantity and bundles capability flags behind the FeatureFlags API (REQ-INV-132), and read and write the INV_ALLOW_NEGATIVE_STOCK and INV_NEAR_EXPIRY_DAYS settings (REQ-INV-065, REQ-INV-118)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.sequence, via: com.erp.sequence.crossmodule.NumberSeriesApi, purpose: "issue the codes INV_WAREHOUSE and INV_BRANCH and the document numbers INV_TRANSFER, INV_COUNT and INV_ADJUSTMENT (RULE-INV-001, RULE-INV-010, RULE-INV-030)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.events, via: com.erp.events.OutboxPublisher, purpose: "record the stock-move event and the inventory master-change event in the change transaction and deliver them after commit (REQ-INV-057, REQ-INV-034)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.audit, via: com.erp.audit.crossmodule.AuditApi, purpose: "record the change history of stock documents, warehouses, branches, lots and Item stock settings (REQ-INV-077)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.mdl, via: com.erp.mdl.crossmodule.MdlLookupApi, purpose: "load the values of the INV_* lookup keys and the CAT unit-of-measure key at runtime (A6)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.tenant, via: com.erp.tenant.TenantProvisioningContributor, purpose: "seed the default branch and the default warehouse of each new tenant (REQ-INV-020, REQ-INV-001)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.tenant, via: com.erp.tenant.TenantRunner, purpose: "run the daily near-expiry check once per tenant (REQ-INV-117)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.sec, via: com.erp.sec.permission.PermissionContributor, purpose: "register the INV page codes so the security module derives their VIEW/CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE permissions, and the grants of the Owner, Seller/Cashier and Warehouse role presets (REQ-INV-136, REQ-INV-137)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.sec, via: com.erp.sec.crossmodule.SecUserDirectoryApi, purpose: "find the users holding the Warehouse role as recipients of the negative-stock and near-expiry notifications (REQ-INV-068, REQ-INV-117)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.notif, via: com.erp.notif.crossmodule.NotificationDispatchApi, purpose: "send the negative-stock and near-expiry notifications (REQ-INV-068, REQ-INV-117)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.report, via: com.erp.report.ReportProvider, purpose: "register the report INV_OPENING_STOCK_SHEET (REQ-INV-073)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.report, via: com.erp.report.crossmodule.PrintApi, purpose: "produce the xlsx opening stock sheet (REQ-INV-073)"}
```

The contract re-creates no given's entity: settings stay in `cu`, lookup values in `mdl`,
numbers in `sequence`, users and roles in `sec`, the tenant in `tenant`.

## 3 — Stability

- v1 is the first contract of INV; every item above is ADDITIVE.
- Items may be added freely. Changing or removing an item a consumer depends on — an identifier
  type, a key column, a signature input or output, an error meaning, an event field — happens
  only in a BREAKING version with an ADR; `gov.py graph` then raises a resolution event on every
  consumer edge that cites it.
- Lookup values of the open keys INV_SOURCE_DOC_TYPE and INV_ADJUSTMENT_REASON grow as data and
  are not a contract change.

## 4 — Decisions applied (no ADR raised)

Every choice here is settled by the SRS and is non-breaking; no ADR was raised and the ADR stream
continues at ADR-INV-014. No question was raised.

| # | Decision | Source |
|---|---|---|
| C-1 | ENTITY items are the SRS SHARED entities (ENT-INV-001, 002, 003, 012, 013). No other module's A8 `module-dependencies` block consumes INV yet; the consumers named are those of the SRS cross-module column and the registry. | SRS A3, A8; engine §1 |
| C-2 | OPERATION items are exactly the SRS A8 "Operations INV offers to other modules" table, one item per row, including its two published events. | SRS A8 |
| C-3 | Reservation and Stock move stay private: consumers hold `reservationPk` and `stockMovePk` only as SOFT references (no FK), returned by CON-INV-011 / 014 / 015 and carried by CON-INV-020. | SRS A3 ownership; D-23 |
| C-4 | Item stock settings stay private; its content is promised only as the read answers of CON-INV-018 and CON-INV-019. | SRS ENT-INV-014 ownership |
| C-5 | A Variant never valued answers zeros in CON-INV-016 instead of "not found", consistent with REQ-INV-041. | SRS D-10 |

Identifiers are written unquoted, so PostgreSQL stores them folded to lower case — one spelling per field, no quoted identifier anywhere. No identifier exceeds the 63-byte limit; none is a reserved word (`KEY` is non-reserved in PostgreSQL and is the given `MDL_LOOKUP_TYPE` column name too). |
| Table names | `INV_` + entity name in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE: INV_WAREHOUSE, INV_BRANCH, INV_STOCK_BALANCE, INV_STOCK_MOVE, INV_RESERVATION, INV_TRANSFER, INV_TRANSFER_LINE, INV_STOCK_COUNT, INV_STOCK_COUNT_LINE, INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT, INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_LINE, INV_LOT, INV_STOCK_VALUATION, INV_ITEM_STOCK_SETTINGS |
| Types declared outside §4.1 | logical `date` (docDate, expiryDate, lotExpiryDate) → `DATE`; logical `number` (whole — ENT-INV-011.rowNo) → `INTEGER` (the syntax map has neither; ADR-INV-016) |
| Precision | quantity and measure `NUMERIC(18,3)`, unit and average cost `NUMERIC(18,4)`, value `NUMERIC(18,2)` — scales from SRS A3 / D-06, precision 18 (ADR-INV-016); lookup codes `VARCHAR(50)` (given `mdl` convention); currency `VARCHAR(3)` ISO 4217 (ADR-INV-015) |

## 3 — XM register (`XM`)

SRS A8 `module-dependencies` consumes four CAT entities. A HARD-FK dependency is registered once per physical column that holds the reference (each column receives its own `constraint → XM-…` pointer and, in P3.1, its own integration block); a SOFT-READ is registered once per consumed entity. CAT's contract `contract-cat.md` (CAT v2, P1.5) is published and carries every consumed entity, so every record is **CONTRACTED**; the column type is the contract's identifier type, BIGINT (CON-CAT-001, CON-CAT-002).

| XM-INV-011 | HARD-FK | CAT · ENT-CAT-001 Item | INV_ITEM_STOCK_SETTINGS.ITEM_FK — column only | `{module: CAT, entity: ENT-CAT-001, type: HARD-FK}` | REQ-INV-124, 125, 129 |
| XM-INV-012 | SOFT-READ | CAT · ENT-CAT-007 Bundle component | read through CON-CAT-007 (component lines with `componentBaseUomCode`) | `{module: CAT, entity: ENT-CAT-007, type: SOFT-READ}` | REQ-INV-042, 049, 053, 054 |
| XM-INV-013 | SOFT-READ | CAT · ENT-CAT-009 Barcode | read through CON-CAT-010 | `{module: CAT, entity: ENT-CAT-009, type: SOFT-READ}` | REQ-INV-072, 088, 091 |

Not XMs, by design:
- ENT-INV-014.measureUomCode (DBF-INV-208) holds a code of the CAT-owned unit-of-measure lookup, stored as a code in a `VARCHAR(50)` column and validated through the given `MdlLookupApi` (SRS A6 "Lookups consumed") — lookup values live in the given `mdl`, not in a CAT table, so no edge exists.
- `SOURCE_DOC_REF` / `SOURCE_LINE_REF` (DBF-INV-048, 050, 071, 073) hold the identifier of the calling module's document with no FK (SRS ENT-INV-004.sourceDocRef "SOFT reference — INV holds no edge to PUR, SLS, SFR"; D-23). PUR, SLS and SFR call INV; the edges point into INV and are minted by their own P2 stages.
- `FK_<TABLE>_TENANT → CORE_TENANT(ID)` targets the given core, which the core documents; audit user columns hold a principal string. Neither is an XM [C:C-GIVEN-1].
- CAT's catalogue-change event (CON-CAT-018) is not consumed in v1 (SRS D-23).

## 4 — FULL_DATABASE_SCRIPT

One consolidated executable for postgresql16 — the module's Flyway migration `V1002__inv_inventory.sql`. Prerequisite: the given `erp-core` is installed in the target schema (its migrations run before any business module), because BLOCK 5d references `CORE_TENANT` and BLOCK 8 seeds the given `mdl`, `sequence`, `notif` and `cu` tables. CAT's tables are **not** a prerequisite: every cross-module column is column-only (§5.1); its constraint is written once, in the integration blocks of the backend plan (P3.1).

```sql
-- =====================================================================
-- INV v1 — Inventory — postgresql16 — no schema prefix
-- Flyway application migration V1002__inv_inventory.sql (V1000+; after CAT
-- V1000 and PTY V1001 — the executor confirms it from the directory listing)
-- Identifier transformation: camelCase field -> UPPER_SNAKE_CASE column,
-- unquoted (stored folded to lower case). PK generation: identity.
-- Logical "date" -> DATE; logical "number" (whole) -> INTEGER (declared once,
-- ADR-INV-016). Quantity NUMERIC(18,3), cost NUMERIC(18,4), value NUMERIC(18,2).
-- Platform columns on every table: TENANT_ID (FK to CORE_TENANT, index led by
-- it, every UNIQUE composite with it) and VERSION — the given AuditableEntity
-- column set (ADR-INV-014). CURRENCY_CODE on monetary rows (CM-8, ADR-INV-015).
-- Cross-module (CAT) columns are column-only: no constraint, live or
-- commented; each carries one pointer to its XM record beside the column.
-- No BEGIN / COMMIT: Flyway runs the migration in its own transaction.
-- =====================================================================

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BLOCK 1 — SEQUENCES
-- none: every PK uses the identity clause; warehouse and branch codes and
-- the transfer, count and adjustment numbers come from the given number
-- series (CORE_NUMBER_SERIES, seeded in BLOCK 8c, through NumberSeriesApi),
-- not from a sequence of this module.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BLOCK 2 — PARENT TABLES (no intra-module FK)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE TABLE INV_BRANCH (
    BRANCH_PK                BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
    IS_DEFAULT_FL            BOOLEAN       DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
    CODE                     VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    NAME_AR                  VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    NAME_EN                  VARCHAR(100),
    IS_ACTIVE_FL             BOOLEAN       DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
    TENANT_ID                BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    VERSION                  BIGINT        DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    CREATED_BY               VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    CREATED_AT               TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL,
    UPDATED_BY               VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    UPDATED_AT               TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE INV_LOT (
    LOT_PK                   BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
    EXPIRY_DATE              DATE          NOT NULL,
    FIRST_RECEIVED_AT        TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL,
    NEAR_EXPIRY_NOTIFIED_AT  TIMESTAMPTZ,
    VARIANT_FK               BIGINT        NOT NULL, -- constraint → XM-INV-009
    CODE                     VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    NAME_AR                  VARCHAR(100),
    NAME_EN                  VARCHAR(100),
    IS_ACTIVE_FL             BOOLEAN       DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
    TENANT_ID                BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    VERSION                  BIGINT        DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    CREATED_BY               VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    CREATED_AT               TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL,
    UPDATED_BY               VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    UPDATED_AT               TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE INV_STOCK_VALUATION (
    STOCK_VALUATION_PK       BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
    TOTAL_ON_HAND_QTY        NUMERIC(18,3) NOT NULL,
    AVERAGE_UNIT_COST        NUMERIC(18,4) NOT NULL,
    STOCK_VALUE              NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL,
    LAST_MOVE_AT             TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL,
    VARIANT_FK               BIGINT        NOT NULL, -- constraint → XM-INV-010
    DOC_DATE                 DATE          NOT NULL,
    TENANT_ID                BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    VERSION                  BIGINT        DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    CURRENCY_CODE            VARCHAR(3)    NOT NULL,
    CREATED_BY               VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    CREATED_AT               TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL,
    UPDATED_BY               VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    UPDATED_AT               TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE INV_ITEM_STOCK_SETTINGS (
    ITEM_STOCK_SETTINGS_PK   BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
    LOT_TRACKED_FL           BOOLEAN       DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
    DUAL_QUANTITY_FL         BOOLEAN       DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
    MEASURE_UOM_CODE         VARCHAR(50),
    ITEM_FK                  BIGINT        NOT NULL, -- constraint → XM-INV-011
    KEY                      VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    VALUE_AR                 VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    VALUE_EN                 VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    IS_ACTIVE_FL             BOOLEAN       DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
    TENANT_ID                BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    VERSION                  BIGINT        DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    CREATED_BY               VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    CREATED_AT               TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL,
    UPDATED_BY               VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    UPDATED_AT               TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BLOCK 3 — CHILD TABLES
-- INV_BRANCH -> INV_WAREHOUSE -> INV_STOCK_BALANCE (also -> INV_LOT)
-- INV_WAREHOUSE -> INV_RESERVATION -> INV_STOCK_MOVE (also -> INV_LOT)
-- INV_WAREHOUSE -> INV_TRANSFER -> INV_TRANSFER_LINE (also -> INV_LOT)
-- INV_WAREHOUSE -> INV_STOCK_COUNT -> INV_STOCK_COUNT_LINE (also -> INV_LOT)
-- INV_WAREHOUSE -> INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT -> INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_LINE (also -> INV_LOT)
-- INV_STOCK_COUNT <-> INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT (both references nullable; the
-- constraints are added in 5d once both tables exist)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE TABLE INV_WAREHOUSE (
    WAREHOUSE_PK             BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
    IS_DEFAULT_FL            BOOLEAN       DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
    BRANCH_FK                BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    CODE                     VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    NAME_AR                  VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    NAME_EN                  VARCHAR(100),
    IS_ACTIVE_FL             BOOLEAN       DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
    TENANT_ID                BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    VERSION                  BIGINT        DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    CREATED_BY               VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,

    UPDATED_BY               VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,

    STOCK_BALANCE_PK         BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,

    DOC_DATE                 DATE          NOT NULL,
    STATUS_CODE              VARCHAR(50)   DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
    TENANT_ID                BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    VERSION                  BIGINT        DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    CREATED_BY               VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,

);

CREATE TABLE INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT (

    DOC_DATE                 DATE          NOT NULL,
    STATUS_CODE              VARCHAR(50)   DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
    TENANT_ID                BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    VERSION                  BIGINT        DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,

    UPDATED_BY               VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    UPDATED_AT               TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE INV_STOCK_COUNT_LINE (
    STOCK_COUNT_LINE_PK      BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,

    LOT_FK                   BIGINT,
    TENANT_ID                BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    VERSION                  BIGINT        DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    CREATED_BY               VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    CREATED_AT               TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL,
    UPDATED_BY               VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    UPDATED_AT               TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_LINE (
    STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_LINE_PK BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,

    LINE_VALUE               NUMERIC(18,2),
    STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_FK      BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    VARIANT_FK               BIGINT        NOT NULL, -- constraint → XM-INV-008
    LOT_FK                   BIGINT,
    TENANT_ID                BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    VERSION                  BIGINT        DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    CURRENCY_CODE            VARCHAR(3)    NOT NULL,
    CREATED_BY               VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,

    UPDATED_AT               TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL
);

ALTER TABLE INV_WAREHOUSE ADD CONSTRAINT PK_INV_WAREHOUSE PRIMARY KEY (WAREHOUSE_PK);

ALTER TABLE INV_TRANSFER ADD CONSTRAINT PK_INV_TRANSFER PRIMARY KEY (TRANSFER_PK);
ALTER TABLE INV_TRANSFER_LINE ADD CONSTRAINT PK_INV_TRANSFER_LINE PRIMARY KEY (TRANSFER_LINE_PK);
ALTER TABLE INV_STOCK_COUNT ADD CONSTRAINT PK_INV_STOCK_COUNT PRIMARY KEY (STOCK_COUNT_PK);
ALTER TABLE INV_STOCK_COUNT_LINE ADD CONSTRAINT PK_INV_STOCK_COUNT_LINE PRIMARY KEY (STOCK_COUNT_LINE_PK);
ALTER TABLE INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT ADD CONSTRAINT PK_INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT PRIMARY KEY (STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_PK);

ALTER TABLE INV_ITEM_STOCK_SETTINGS ADD CONSTRAINT PK_INV_ITEM_STOCK_SETTINGS PRIMARY KEY (ITEM_STOCK_SETTINGS_PK);

-- 5b UNIQUE — every one led by TENANT_ID (ADR-INV-014)
-- Tenant-scoped parent keys, targets of the composite intra-module FKs (5d)
ALTER TABLE INV_BRANCH ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_INV_BRANCH_TENANT_PK UNIQUE (TENANT_ID, BRANCH_PK);
ALTER TABLE INV_WAREHOUSE ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_INV_WAREHOUSE_TENANT_PK UNIQUE (TENANT_ID, WAREHOUSE_PK);
ALTER TABLE INV_LOT ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_INV_LOT_TENANT_PK UNIQUE (TENANT_ID, LOT_PK);
ALTER TABLE INV_RESERVATION ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_INV_RESERVATION_TENANT_PK UNIQUE (TENANT_ID, RESERVATION_PK);
ALTER TABLE INV_TRANSFER ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_INV_TRANSFER_TENANT_PK UNIQUE (TENANT_ID, TRANSFER_PK);
ALTER TABLE INV_STOCK_COUNT ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_INV_STOCK_COUNT_TENANT_PK UNIQUE (TENANT_ID, STOCK_COUNT_PK);
ALTER TABLE INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_TENANT_PK UNIQUE (TENANT_ID, STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_PK);
-- Codes and names of warehouses and branches (RULE-INV-001, RULE-INV-002, RULE-INV-010, RULE-INV-011)

ALTER TABLE INV_WAREHOUSE ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_INV_WAREHOUSE_NAME_AR UNIQUE (TENANT_ID, NAME_AR);

ALTER TABLE INV_BRANCH ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_INV_BRANCH_NAME_AR UNIQUE (TENANT_ID, NAME_AR);

ALTER TABLE INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_DOC_NO UNIQUE (TENANT_ID, DOC_NO);
-- One line per Variant and lot on a transfer or adjustment (RULE-INV-048); repeated scans add to one count line (REQ-INV-088, SRS D-14)
ALTER TABLE INV_TRANSFER_LINE ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_INV_TRANSFER_LINE_TRF_VAR_LOT

    UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (TENANT_ID, STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_FK, VARIANT_FK, LOT_NO);

ALTER TABLE INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_LINE ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_LINE_ADJ_ROW
    UNIQUE (TENANT_ID, STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_FK, ROW_NO);

ALTER TABLE INV_LOT ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_INV_LOT_VAR_CODE UNIQUE (TENANT_ID, VARIANT_FK, CODE);

ALTER TABLE INV_STOCK_VALUATION ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_INV_STOCK_VALUATION_VARIANT_FK UNIQUE (TENANT_ID, VARIANT_FK);
-- At most one Item stock settings record per Item (RULE-INV-045)
ALTER TABLE INV_ITEM_STOCK_SETTINGS ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_INV_ITEM_STOCK_SETTINGS_ITEM_FK UNIQUE (TENANT_ID, ITEM_FK);
-- Conditional uniqueness: postgresql16 expresses a partial UNIQUE only as a
-- unique index (not an ALTER TABLE constraint); each leads with TENANT_ID.
-- At most one default warehouse and one default branch per tenant (RULE-INV-006, RULE-INV-015)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UQ_INV_WAREHOUSE_IS_DEFAULT_FL ON INV_WAREHOUSE (TENANT_ID) WHERE IS_DEFAULT_FL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UQ_INV_BRANCH_IS_DEFAULT_FL ON INV_BRANCH (TENANT_ID) WHERE IS_DEFAULT_FL;

-- 5c CHECK
-- RULE-INV-006 — the default warehouse is active
ALTER TABLE INV_WAREHOUSE ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_WAREHOUSE_IS_DEFAULT_FL
    CHECK (NOT IS_DEFAULT_FL OR IS_ACTIVE_FL);
-- RULE-INV-002 — a non-blank Arabic name
ALTER TABLE INV_WAREHOUSE ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_WAREHOUSE_NAME_AR
    CHECK (BTRIM(NAME_AR) <> '');
-- RULE-INV-015 — the default branch is active
ALTER TABLE INV_BRANCH ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_BRANCH_IS_DEFAULT_FL
    CHECK (NOT IS_DEFAULT_FL OR IS_ACTIVE_FL);
-- RULE-INV-011 — a non-blank Arabic name
ALTER TABLE INV_BRANCH ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_BRANCH_NAME_AR
    CHECK (BTRIM(NAME_AR) <> '');
-- SRS A6 — closed set INV_MOVE_TYPE (fixed by REQ-INV-051, 052, 080, 099)
ALTER TABLE INV_STOCK_MOVE ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_STOCK_MOVE_MOVE_TYPE_CODE
    CHECK (MOVE_TYPE_CODE IN ('RECEIPT', 'RETURN_IN', 'ISSUE', 'RETURN_OUT', 'TRANSFER_OUT', 'TRANSFER_IN', 'ADJUSTMENT_IN', 'ADJUSTMENT_OUT'));
-- RULE-INV-017 — quantity greater than 0; a measure-only adjustment move carries 0 with a measure (REQ-INV-123, ADR-INV-017)
ALTER TABLE INV_STOCK_MOVE ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_STOCK_MOVE_QUANTITY
    CHECK (QUANTITY > 0 OR (QUANTITY = 0 AND MOVE_TYPE_CODE IN ('ADJUSTMENT_IN', 'ADJUSTMENT_OUT') AND COALESCE(MEASURE_QTY, 0) > 0));
-- RULE-INV-040 — a measure, when present, is greater than 0
ALTER TABLE INV_STOCK_MOVE ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_STOCK_MOVE_MEASURE_QTY
    CHECK (MEASURE_QTY IS NULL OR MEASURE_QTY > 0);
-- RULE-INV-025 — unit cost 0 or more
ALTER TABLE INV_STOCK_MOVE ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_STOCK_MOVE_UNIT_COST
    CHECK (UNIT_COST >= 0);
-- ADR-INV-015 — an ISO 4217 code (three capital letters)
ALTER TABLE INV_STOCK_MOVE ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_STOCK_MOVE_CURRENCY_CODE
    CHECK (CURRENCY_CODE ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$');
-- SRS A7 — status values of the closed reservation lifecycle (INV_RESERVATION_STATUS)
ALTER TABLE INV_RESERVATION ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_RESERVATION_STATUS_CODE
    CHECK (STATUS_CODE IN ('ACTIVE', 'CONSUMED', 'RELEASED'));
-- RULE-INV-017 — requested quantity greater than 0
ALTER TABLE INV_RESERVATION ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_RESERVATION_ORIGINAL_QTY
    CHECK (ORIGINAL_QTY > 0);
-- ENT-INV-005 — remaining quantity 0 or more and never above the requested quantity
ALTER TABLE INV_RESERVATION ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_RESERVATION_RESERVED_QTY
    CHECK (RESERVED_QTY >= 0 AND RESERVED_QTY <= ORIGINAL_QTY);
-- RULE-INV-020 — shortfall 0 or more
ALTER TABLE INV_RESERVATION ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_RESERVATION_SHORTFALL_QTY
    CHECK (SHORTFALL_QTY >= 0);
-- REQ-INV-046, REQ-INV-047 — a closed reservation records when it closed
ALTER TABLE INV_RESERVATION ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_RESERVATION_CLOSED_AT
    CHECK (STATUS_CODE = 'ACTIVE' OR CLOSED_AT IS NOT NULL);
-- SRS A7 — status values of the closed document lifecycle (INV_DOC_STATUS)
ALTER TABLE INV_TRANSFER ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_TRANSFER_STATUS_CODE
    CHECK (STATUS_CODE IN ('DRAFT', 'POSTED', 'CANCELLED'));
-- RULE-INV-016 — source and destination differ
ALTER TABLE INV_TRANSFER ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_TRANSFER_TO_WAREHOUSE_FK
    CHECK (FROM_WAREHOUSE_FK <> TO_WAREHOUSE_FK);
-- REQ-INV-080 — a posted transfer records when it was posted
ALTER TABLE INV_TRANSFER ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_TRANSFER_POSTED_AT
    CHECK (STATUS_CODE <> 'POSTED' OR POSTED_AT IS NOT NULL);
-- RULE-INV-017 — quantity greater than 0
ALTER TABLE INV_TRANSFER_LINE ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_TRANSFER_LINE_QUANTITY
    CHECK (QUANTITY > 0);
-- RULE-INV-040 — a measure, when present, is greater than 0
ALTER TABLE INV_TRANSFER_LINE ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_TRANSFER_LINE_MEASURE_QTY
    CHECK (MEASURE_QTY IS NULL OR MEASURE_QTY > 0);
-- RULE-INV-025 — unit cost 0 or more
ALTER TABLE INV_TRANSFER_LINE ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_TRANSFER_LINE_UNIT_COST
    CHECK (UNIT_COST IS NULL OR UNIT_COST >= 0);
-- ADR-INV-015 — an ISO 4217 code
ALTER TABLE INV_TRANSFER_LINE ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_TRANSFER_LINE_CURRENCY_CODE
    CHECK (CURRENCY_CODE ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$');
-- SRS A7 — INV_DOC_STATUS
ALTER TABLE INV_STOCK_COUNT ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_STOCK_COUNT_STATUS_CODE
    CHECK (STATUS_CODE IN ('DRAFT', 'POSTED', 'CANCELLED'));
-- REQ-INV-092 — a posted count records when it was posted

ALTER TABLE INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_LINE ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_LINE_CURRENCY_CODE

ALTER TABLE INV_STOCK_VALUATION ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_INV_STOCK_VALUATION_CURRENCY_CODE

-- Cross-module (CAT) references are column-only (§5.1): the eleven HARD-FK
-- columns carry their pointer beside the column in BLOCK 2 / BLOCK 3
-- (XM-INV-001 … XM-INV-011); their constraints are written once, in the
-- integration blocks of the backend plan (P3.1).
--
-- XM-INV-012 SOFT-READ — this module's bundle availability, reservation and issue
-- services read CAT Bundle component lines (ENT-CAT-007: componentVariantFk,
-- quantity, componentBaseUomCode) from CAT without an FK, through getItem
-- (CON-CAT-007; entity promise CON-CAT-006). Rationale: a bundle holds no stock;
-- its availability, reservation and issue explode to its components (POL-INV-014,
-- SRS A8). Risk: changes to ENT-CAT-007 require impact assessment on REQ-INV-042,
-- REQ-INV-049, REQ-INV-053, REQ-INV-054.
--
-- XM-INV-013 SOFT-READ — this module's count-line and opening-stock services read
-- CAT barcodes (ENT-CAT-009: barcodeValue to variantPk) from CAT without an FK,
-- through lookupBarcode (CON-CAT-010; entity promise CON-CAT-005). Rationale: count
-- scanning and opening-stock rows resolve a barcode to its Variant (SRS A8).
-- Risk: changes to ENT-CAT-009 require impact assessment on REQ-INV-072,
-- REQ-INV-088, REQ-INV-091.

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BLOCK 6 — TRIGGERS
-- none: no SRS RULE requires a database trigger. Change history
-- (REQ-INV-077) is the given audit module (AuditApi); the immutability of
-- stock moves (RULE-INV-023), the read-only codes and numbers (RULE-INV-001,
-- 010, 030), the balance and valuation updates (REQ-INV-036, 059) and the
-- read-only posted documents (RULE-INV-029) are service behaviour (P3.1).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BLOCK 7 — INDEXES (non-PK). One index per table is led by TENANT_ID.
-- FK columns already covered by a UNIQUE whose leading columns are
-- (TENANT_ID, FK) are not indexed twice: INV_STOCK_BALANCE.VARIANT_FK,
-- INV_TRANSFER_LINE.TRANSFER_FK, INV_STOCK_COUNT_LINE.STOCK_COUNT_FK,
-- INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_LINE.STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_FK, INV_LOT.VARIANT_FK,
-- INV_STOCK_VALUATION.VARIANT_FK, INV_ITEM_STOCK_SETTINGS.ITEM_FK.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Tenant-led indexes, each serving a list or check of the SRS
-- active warehouse / branch lists and counts (REQ-INV-010, 019, 029, 033)
CREATE INDEX IDX_INV_WAREHOUSE_TENANT ON INV_WAREHOUSE (TENANT_ID, IS_ACTIVE_FL);
CREATE INDEX IDX_INV_BRANCH_TENANT ON INV_BRANCH (TENANT_ID, IS_ACTIVE_FL);
-- balances of a warehouse; deactivation check (RULE-INV-004); FK WAREHOUSE_FK
CREATE INDEX IDX_INV_STOCK_BALANCE_TENANT ON INV_STOCK_BALANCE (TENANT_ID, WAREHOUSE_FK);
-- move history of a Variant in a warehouse by date (REQ-INV-075, 076); FK VARIANT_FK
CREATE INDEX IDX_INV_STOCK_MOVE_TENANT ON INV_STOCK_MOVE (TENANT_ID, VARIANT_FK, WAREHOUSE_FK, DOC_DATE);
-- reserved quantity of a Variant in a warehouse (REQ-INV-038); FK VARIANT_FK
CREATE INDEX IDX_INV_RESERVATION_TENANT ON INV_RESERVATION (TENANT_ID, VARIANT_FK, WAREHOUSE_FK, STATUS_CODE);
-- document searches by status and date, newest first (REQ-INV-086, 095, 104)
CREATE INDEX IDX_INV_TRANSFER_TENANT ON INV_TRANSFER (TENANT_ID, STATUS_CODE, DOC_DATE);
CREATE INDEX IDX_INV_STOCK_COUNT_TENANT ON INV_STOCK_COUNT (TENANT_ID, STATUS_CODE, DOC_DATE);
CREATE INDEX IDX_INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_TENANT ON INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT (TENANT_ID, STATUS_CODE, DOC_DATE);
-- lines by Variant; FK VARIANT_FK
CREATE INDEX IDX_INV_TRANSFER_LINE_TENANT ON INV_TRANSFER_LINE (TENANT_ID, VARIANT_FK);
CREATE INDEX IDX_INV_STOCK_COUNT_LINE_TENANT ON INV_STOCK_COUNT_LINE (TENANT_ID, VARIANT_FK);
CREATE INDEX IDX_INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_LINE_TENANT ON INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_LINE (TENANT_ID, VARIANT_FK);
-- lots by expiry: near-expiry list, daily check, FEFO (REQ-INV-110, 116, 117)
CREATE INDEX IDX_INV_LOT_TENANT ON INV_LOT (TENANT_ID, EXPIRY_DATE);
-- valuation non-zero filter (SCR-REQ-INV-012 B2)
CREATE INDEX IDX_INV_STOCK_VALUATION_TENANT ON INV_STOCK_VALUATION (TENANT_ID, TOTAL_ON_HAND_QTY);
-- capability turn-off check and settings filters (RULE-INV-046; SCR-REQ-INV-009 B2)
```
